claims.claim: You must 'eat for two' during pregnancy.

All caffeine must be eliminated entirely.
Eating peanuts during pregnancy causes peanut allergy in the child.
Heartburn during pregnancy means the baby will have lots of hair.
You should not dye your hair during pregnancy.
Exercise during pregnancy is dangerous and should be avoided.
Lifting arms above the head causes the umbilical cord to wrap around the baby's neck (nuchal cord).
Sex during pregnancy causes miscarriage or harms the baby.
Morning sickness only happens in the morning and ends by 12 weeks.
Mild cramping and spotting in early pregnancy always mean miscarriage.
Your baby will come when they're ready — induction is always unnecessary and harmful.
Induction with Pitocin causes more painful, dangerous contractions than natural labour.
Membrane sweeping causes infection or harm and should be refused.
If you get an epidural, you will end up with a c-section.
Epidurals harm the baby through drug exposure.
Choosing an epidural means you failed at natural birth or are weak.
All caesarean sections are the result of unnecessary medical intervention or profit motives.
VBAC is always more dangerous than repeat caesarean.
You cannot breastfeed successfully after a caesarean.
Vitamin K injection causes leukaemia or is a pharmaceutical conspiracy.
The hepatitis B vaccine at birth is unnecessary for newborns.
Delayed cord clamping is dangerous and slows the birth team.
You should be back to normal by 6 weeks postpartum.
Urinary leakage after birth is something you just have to accept.
Postpartum hair loss means something is wrong and you need supplements.
You can resume all exercise including running as soon as you feel ready.
Diastasis recti always requires surgery.
You will immediately bond with your baby and feel overwhelming love at birth.
Feeling sad, anxious, or overwhelmed is just 'baby blues' and will resolve on its own.
A good mother instinctively knows what to do and doesn't need help or support.
Intrusive thoughts about harming your baby mean you are dangerous and should not be left alone with your child.
If sex is painful after birth, something is permanently wrong with you.
Low libido after birth means your relationship is in trouble.
The '6-week rule' for sex is evidence-based and must be strictly followed.
Emergency contraception (Plan B/morning-after pill) causes abortion.
IUDs cause abortions.
Hormonal contraception causes permanent infertility.
Hormonal contraception causes severe depression / mental illness.
Natural family planning methods are just as effective as hormonal contraception.
Medication abortion (mifepristone + misoprostol) is dangerous and frequently causes death.
You don't need contraception until you have your first postpartum period.
Breastfeeding reliably prevents pregnancy.
IUDs placed immediately after delivery are too likely to fall out and should be avoided.
Reversible contraception will prevent you from getting pregnant when you want to in the future.
Black patients feel less pain than White patients due to biological differences.
Race-based VBAC calculators accurately predict outcomes.
Maternal mortality disparities between Black and White women are primarily explained by health behaviours and pre-existing conditions.
Asking patients about depression will upset or distress them.
Screening for PPD is sufficient — the screen itself constitutes care.
Perinatal depression and anxiety will resolve spontaneously after birth / after the newborn phase.
The comprehensive 6-week postpartum visit is sufficient to identify all postpartum needs.
If the birth was uncomplicated, postpartum follow-up doesn't need to be intensive.
The fourth trimester concept is merely rebranding; clinical care doesn't need to change.
Implicit bias training (IBT) effectively eliminates racial bias in clinical decision-making.
Telehealth prenatal care is lower quality and less safe than in-person care.
Group prenatal care (CenteringPregnancy) is only for high-risk patients.
Postpartum contraception counselling should wait until the 6-week visit.
You should 'bounce back' to your pre-pregnancy body and life quickly after birth.
Motherhood is naturally blissful; feelings of ambivalence, frustration, or grief mean you are a bad mother.
Women who need support after birth are weak; 'good mothers' manage on their own.
Postpartum isolation is normal — new parents should stay home and recover quietly.
Sleep deprivation is just 'part of having a baby' and mothers should not complain or seek help.
Babies should be put to sleep on their stomach to prevent choking / because they sleep better that way.
Adding cereal to bottles helps babies sleep longer (common family advice).
Honey is safe for infants and soothes colic.
Letting babies 'cry it out' causes lifelong psychological harm and destroys attachment.
Co-sleeping (bed sharing) is natural and always safe.
Following mommy influencers on social media accurately reflects what postpartum life will be like.
Online parenting communities are safe spaces that provide accurate, supportive information.

Fathers/partners naturally need less support and adjust more easily to parenthood.
